messages.content: 誰是目前排名第一的網球選手？

function.name: sports_team_standing
function.description: Retrieve the current standing/ranking of a sports team in its respective league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the sports team.

league.description: The league in which the team participates.

season_year.description: The season year for which the standing is needed. If not provided, current year is assumed. Default: 1994

message.content:
I’m afraid I don’t have access to live‑time data or a dedicated API call for individual athlete rankings, so I can’t tell you who holds the world No 1 spot at exactly this moment.  

If it helps, here’s what was true most recently:

| Category | Ranking system | Current #1 (as of my last update) |
|----------|-----------------|-----------------------------------|
| Men’s singles | ATP World Tour Rankings | **Carlos Alcaraz** (Spain), after winning the Australian Open 2024 |
| Women’s singles | WTA Rankings | **Aryna Sabalenka** (Belarus), following her victory at the French Open 2024 |

These positions change weekly based on tournament results, so for the absolute latest information you’ll want to check the official ATP/WTA websites or their mobile apps right now.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "Who is currently ranked first tennis player?" They want ranking info. We can use the tool `sports_team_standing` but that's for teams; we need individual players. There's no direct tool for this. So we cannot fetch via API. We'll answer with knowledge up-to-date as of last training (June 2024). But question says "currently" - maybe they expect real-time data? As an AI offline, can't get live updates. Could say I don't have access to real-time rankings.

We should respond politely and explain limitation. Possibly provide latest known top-ranked male/female if relevant. Provide context about ATP/WTA rankings. Let's do that.
